owner_safe.note: Threshold 5 of 5 with 0x…dead as an owner: dead cannot sign (no key, no code for ERC-1271, cannot approveHash). No modules or guard. The Safe can no longer execute, so owner() of BlurExchangeV2, Blend and Blur Pool can no longer upgrade or reconfigure them.

blur_exchange_v2.note: SetOracle logs read with eth_getLogs (rpc.mevblocker.io) blocks 17,000,000-26,431,500. Every take* entry point has verifyOracleSignature, which reverts when oracles[oracle]==0.

blend.note: Lender offers with oracle == address(0) skip the oracle check (Signatures._verifyOfferAuthorization).

blur_pool.note: transferFrom callable by EXCHANGE, EXCHANGE_V2 (0xb2ecfe4e… found in implementation code), SWAP, BLEND (0x29469395… found in implementation code).
